productions.title: Will Liverman in Concert
productions.description: GRAMMY-winning baritone Will Liverman performs his original music and classical favorites. Add-on performance.

productions.title: La bohème
productions.description: Libretto by Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa. E. Loren Meeker's production, with Karen Chia-ling Ho and Demetrious Sampson.

productions.title: The Pigeon Keeper
productions.description: Libretto by Stephanie Fleischmann. Part of the Family Opera Series; a new opera with cinematic projections and children's chorus.

productions.title: Ariadne auf Naxos
productions.description: Libretto by Hugo von Hofmannsthal. Opera Omaha's first Strauss opera, conducted by Steven White, directed by Chas Rader-Shieber.

productions.title: Alessandro
productions.description: Libretto by Thomas Broughton. The English Concert performs this rarely staged Handel opera on period instruments.
